title: kb-sprint close never recognises the harness's worktree-agent branches, which carry no commits
goal: The /kb-sprint close cleanup also removes a worktree-agent-<x> branch the harness created for a sprint subagent: such a branch stays at its base commit while the subagent works on work/<id>, so it has no commits and no KB-Work trailers and the trailer test never matches it. The skill counts it as the sprint's when .claude/worktrees/agent-<x> had one of the sprint's work/<id> branches checked out (git worktree list --porcelain, read before removal) and removes it when it has no commits beyond origin/main. Found by the SP-rhgeod5g review.
